answer: Each attestation is a crystal receipt bound to the attester's epoch key, so a cluster of clones attesting each other forms a closed pigment loop that the replay detects and discounts to zero. An adversary must as a result acquire 6 genuinely independent identities per alias, which is exactly the cost the mechanism is designed to impose, and the island tally makes that independence checkable by anyone. Collateral of 72 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
